log.notes_to_self: Day1: killed only 2 national (safe, quick, morning). Plan: watch the day-3 pool; if it stays 10M, L sees little about the sources, so then add the others gradually. Free blocks: morning, afternoon. Region Kita, web, police, foreign reader.

Region Kita, night worker, reader of web, police, foreign. Strategy: stay with national kills only (leaks nothing) until pool feedback shows how much L sees; then add sources cautiously, keeping any busy-block deaths at 2 or fewer per day.

Worst-case leak factors if L sees them: web ~3.3x, regional 10x, foreign 25x, police 50x. Caught at pool <=100k, so total worst-case product must stay under 100x. Check day-6 conference: if the pool dropped to ~3M, web is visible to L, so stop web and consider other sources carefully. If it is still 10M, web is safe, so keep using it and cautiously test regional next. Avoid police and foreign unless the data shows they are safe. Free blocks: morning, afternoon. Never put more than 2 deaths in busy blocks.
